short: Runs its own code or commands on the victim’s computer.
analogy: Once inside, takes out its tools and switches them on.

solutionNotes.edr: Sees which program launched what, and stops the malicious process.
solutionNotes.siem: Records and correlates commands and program launches from all systems.
solutionNotes.cnapp: Spots suspicious commands and foreign containers in the cloud and Kubernetes.
solutionNotes.vm: Closes vulnerabilities in programs that are used to run malicious code.
solutionNotes.dast: Tests your own web applications and AI services for injection.
